intro: Tell me the matter in your own words: whom to contact and their email address, what to ask for, whether to set up a meeting and until when. I read it back to you, and nothing is sent until you confirm.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.p1: The AI executive assistant runs matters for you by email. To do that, your requests, the emails it writes and the replies it receives are processed by OpenAI through our server.
consent.p2: OpenAI does not keep them for training and they are not stored in its dashboard. We keep your matters, their emails and their history in your account, so you can see what happened.
consent.p3: Nothing is sent without your confirmation. You can delete a matter, or your whole account, at any time, and the emails of a finished matter are deleted after the retention period.
consent.p4: Do you agree to use the assistant this way?
consent.subtitle: How your assistant handles your data

settings.title: Assistant settings

settings.sendFromMailbox: New matters send from my mailbox

settings.length: How long a matter runs when you do not say
settings.briefing: Briefing before a meeting it booked
settings.appliesHint: Follow-ups, the language, the copy rule and these defaults apply to new matters. To change a running matter, use Change on its page.
settings.invalid: Working hours must end after they start.
settings.subtitle: How your assistant works for you. Changes apply when you save.
settings.followUpsHint: When a contact does not answer, the assistant writes again.
